title: केबिन नंबर 4 के 3 खौफनाक नियम: सुनसान रेलवे फाटक की रात
topic: जंगल के बीच बने एक पुराने रेलवे केबिन में रात की ड्यूटी के तीन जानलेवा नियम और एक भयानक सच।
description:
घने जंगलों के बीच बने केबिन नंबर 4 पर जब विक्रम अपनी पहली रात की ड्यूटी पर पहुंचा, तो पुराने गेटमैन ने उसे डायरी में लिखे तीन नियम थमा दिए। नियम टूटे तो क्या हुआ? सुनिए एक रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाली थ्रिलर कहानी।
#HorrorStoryHindi #RaatKeKisse #RailwayCrossing #HindiKahaniya #ThrillerStory

characters.Vikram: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle.
characters.Ramashray: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler.
characters.Chhaya: A 30-year-old Indian woman, pale ghostly face, vacant wide dark eyes, long unbraided pitch-black wet hair, slender frail build, wearing a torn plain yellow saree with a dark green border.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रात के ठीक दो बजकर चालीस मिनट पर, जंग लगे रेलवे ट्रैक पर एक ऐसी ट्रेन की सीटी गूंजी, जो कागज़ों में तीस साल पहले खाई में गिर चुकी थी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, looking in sheer horror through a dust-covered glass window of a rustic Indian railway cabin at midnight, fog rolling outside, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: अगर मैंने तीसरा नियम तोड़ दिया... तो मैं इस केबिन से कभी जिंदा बाहर नहीं निकल पाऊंगा!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, backing away in extreme fear inside a dimly lit vintage wooden cabin, yellow kerosene lamp flickering, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन यह खौफनाक खेल शुरू हुआ था शाम के सात बजे, जब विक्रम अपनी नई पोस्टिंग पर केबिन नंबर 4 पहुंचा था।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, walking along an isolated rural railway track surrounded by dense misty sal trees at dusk, carrying a tiffin box, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: यह रेलवे फाटक घने साल के जंगलों के बीच था, जहां मीलों तक न कोई सड़क थी, न इंसानी बस्ती।
scenes.visual: A solitary two-story colonial brick railway cabin beside closed rusted crossing gates in an eerie dense Indian forest at twilight, thick mist gathering on the gravel tracks, moody dramatic lighting, establishing wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लकड़ी की सीढ़ियां चढ़कर जब विक्रम ऊपर पहुंचा, तो वहां पहले से तैनात गेटमैन रामाश्रय अपनी लालटेन बुझा रहा था।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, turning down a metal kerosene lantern on a rough wooden table inside the rustic cabin, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: नमस्ते चाचा! मैं विक्रम, आज रात से मेरी ड्यूटी शुरू है।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, standing at the open cabin doorway with an uncertain polite smile, evening gloom behind him, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: आ गए तुम? अच्छा है... पर सुनो लड़के, यह आम रेलवे केबिन नहीं है। यहां रात गुज़ारने के तीन कायदे हैं।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, staring grimly and sternly at the newcomer under a swinging bulb, cold shadowy atmosphere, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रामाश्रय ने एक पुरानी लाल चमड़े की डायरी मेज़ पर पटकी, जिसके पन्नों पर अजीब से निशान बने थे।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, resting his palm on an old leather-bound logbook placed on an aged wooden desk, dim cabin interior, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: पहला नियम: रात 1:15 पर एक मालगाड़ी गुज़रेगी। ड्राइवर को कभी हरी बत्ती मत दिखाना, सिर्फ लाल झंडी दिखाना, चाहे वो कितनी भी सीटी बजाए।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, pointing an assertive finger outward while giving strict instructions, shadows deepening on his face, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: लेकिन चाचा, अगर मालगाड़ी को लाल झंडी दिखाई तो वो रुक जाएगी! ट्रैक ब्लॉक हो जाएगा।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, gesturing with confusion and skepticism, cabin levers and dials in the background, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: वो नहीं रुकेगी! और दूसरा नियम कान खोलकर सुन ले... रात दो बजे के करीब ट्रैक पर लालटेन लिए कोई औरत खड़ी दिखेगी।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, leaning close with an intense whispered expression, dimly lit cabin, medium close-up.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: वार्निंग बेल मत बजाना। खिड़की के पर्दे गिरा लेना और अपनी आँखें मूंद लेना। वो सिर्फ देखने आती है कि अंदर कौन है।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, touching the dusty canvas window blind with a grave face, moody interior light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: और तीसरा नियम क्या है चाचा?
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, looking genuinely disturbed, gripping the strap of his bag, night darkness outside, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: तीसरा नियम सबसे अहम है... 2:40 पर एक खाली स्टीम इंजन गुज़रेगा। उसे लॉगबुक रजिस्टर में कभी दर्ज मत करना। अगर दस्तखत कर दिए, तो तुम्हारी आत्मा इस केबिन में बंध जाएगी।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, pointing downward toward the open register book on the table, chilling atmosphere, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: इतना कहकर रामाश्रय बिना कुछ और सुने अपनी लाठी टेकते हुए नीचे उतर गया और रात के घने कोहरे में गायब हो गया।
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, walking away into dense nocturnal mist along the desolate Indian railway embankment, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: केबिन में सन्नाटा इतना गहरा था कि विक्रम को दीवार पर लटकी पुरानी घड़ी की टिक-टिक अपनी छाती पर हथौड़े जैसी लग रही थी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, sitting alone on a wooden stool under an amber filament bulb, staring at a vintage pendulum clock on the wooden wall, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: घड़ी की सुइयां जैसे ही एक बजकर पंद्रह मिनट पर पहुंचीं, दूर सन्नाटे को चीरती हुई एक कर्कश सीटी सुनाई दी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, standing up abruptly in panic, turning his head toward the dark track outside the window, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: एक भारी-भरकम मालगाड़ी धुंध को चीरते हुए फाटक की तरफ बढ़ रही थी, लेकिन उसके आगे कोई हेडलाइट नहीं जल रही थी।
scenes.visual: A massive pitch-black freight train emerging silently through the dense white fog on a curved railway line in the dark Indian wilderness, no front lamp glowing, eerie moonlight reflecting off cold steel rails, wide cinematic shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: हरी बत्ती नहीं... मुझे सिर्फ लाल झंडी दिखानी है!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, grabbing a rolled red fabric flag from a wooden rack, hands tense, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: विक्रम ने कांपते हाथों से खिड़की खोली और लाल झंडी बाहर लहरा दी। ट्रेन बिना रुके उसके ठीक नीचे से धड़धड़ाती हुई गुज़री।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, leaning out of the second-floor cabin window holding out a red flag into the icy wind, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: जब इंजन का केबिन सामने आया, तो विक्रम की रूह कांप गई—ड्राइवर की सीट पर कोई इंसान नहीं, बल्कि धुएं से बना एक काला साया खड़ा था, जिसकी आंखें जलते कोयले जैसी थीं!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, gasping in horror as a shadowy silhouette with glowing embers for eyes stares up from the roaring train below, dramatic angle, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगर उसने हरी बत्ती दिखाई होती, तो वह साया केबिन के अंदर दाखिल हो जाता। पहला नियम सच साबित हो चुका था।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, slumping against the wooden wall, panting heavily, clutching his chest in relief, amber cabin lighting, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगर इस अनसुलझे रहस्य ने आपकी भी धड़कनें बढ़ा दी हैं, तो 'रात के किस्से' को अभी सब्सक्राइब करें और बेल आइकॉन दबाएं।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, pouring cold water from an earthen pitcher into a steel cup, eyes still alert and watchful, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अब समय था रात के एक बजकर बचपन मिनट। बाहर जंगल में अचानक सन्नाटा इतना गहरा हो गया कि हवा की सरसराहट भी बंद हो गई।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, looking warily through the cabin window pane into the still, frozen moonlit forest, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रेलवे ट्रैक के ठीक बीचों-बीच, कोहरे की चादर के बीच एक पीली रोशनी डगमगाते हुए जलने लगी।
scenes.visual: A 30-year-old Indian woman, pale ghostly face, vacant wide dark eyes, long unbraided pitch-black wet hair, slender frail build, wearing a torn plain yellow saree with a dark green border, standing motionless between railway tracks in the fog, holding an old rusted lantern, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: वही औरत! ट्रैक के बीच खड़ी है... वार्निंग बेल नहीं बजानी, आंखें फेर लेनी हैं...
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, hesitating near the brass emergency bell lever, whispering in dread, sweat on his brow, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: विक्रम ने तुरंत खिड़की के भारी कैनवास के पर्दे गिरा दिए और पीठ फेरकर केबिन के कोने में बैठ गया।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, rapidly pulling down a thick torn curtain over the cabin window, desperate expression, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी लकड़ी की सीढ़ियों पर किसी के नंगे पैरों की चाप सुनाई दी... छप... छप... जैसे कोई भीगे कपड़ों में ऊपर चढ़ रहा हो।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, crouching low against the wooden floorboards, staring wide-eyed at the bolted cabin door, tense low angle, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: G
scenes.text: केबिन बाबू... ज़रा फाटक खोल दो... मेरी बच्ची उस पार छूट गई है...
scenes.visual: A 30-year-old Indian woman, pale ghostly face, vacant wide dark eyes, long unbraided pitch-black wet hair, slender frail build, wearing a torn plain yellow saree with a dark green border, standing just outside the frosted glass door panel, her dark silhouette pressed against the misted glass, eerie moonlight, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: विक्रम के होंठ थरथरा रहे थे। उसने दोनों हाथों से अपने कान दबा लिए और हनुमान चालीसा दोहराने लगा।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, sitting curled up, eyes squeezed tight, muttering silent prayers under the flickering yellow bulb, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कुछ पलों के बाद वह खौफनाक आवाज़ हवा में विलीन हो गई। दूसरा नियम भी पूरा हो चुका था, लेकिन सबसे भयानक परीक्षा अभी बाकी थी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, slowly opening his eyes, standing up with trembling knees, looking at the silent doorway, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: घड़ी ने दो बजकर पैंतीस मिनट बजाए। तभी केबिन के पुराने लैंडलाइन फोन की घंटी बज उठी—ट्रिंग... ट्रिंग...
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, staring with sudden dread at a heavy black rotary dial telephone ringing loudly on the wooden wall, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: हैलो? कौन है?
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, lifting the black telephone receiver to his ear with hesitant fingers, shadows covering his face, medium close-up.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: विक्रम! मैं रामाश्रय बोल रहा हूं। 2:40 वाली ट्रेन आ रही है, उसे लॉगबुक में दर्ज करके तुरंत दस्तखत कर देना, वरना हेडक्वार्टर से सस्पेंड हो जाओगे!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, listening intently to the receiver, sudden suspicion and shock crossing his eyes, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: विक्रम ठिठक गया। रामाश्रय ने जाते वक्त खुद कहा था कि तीसरे इंजन की एंट्री कभी रजिस्टर में मत करना!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, staring at the open red leather logbook on the desk, holding an ink pen in confusion, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी उसकी नज़र केबिन की दीवार पर टंगे एक पुराने, धूल भरे ग्रुप फोटो पर पड़ी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, shining a metal flashlight at a framed black-and-white photograph hanging askew on the wooden wall, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उस फोटो के नीचे लिखा था: 'स्वर्गीय रामाश्रय शर्मा, जिनकी सन् 1994 में केबिन नंबर 4 पर ड्यूटी के दौरान रहस्यमयी मौत हो गई थी।'
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, recoiling in utter horror as the beam of light illuminates the framed obituary photograph of the old man, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: रामाश्रय चाचा... तीस साल पहले मर चुके हैं?! तो मुझे नियम बताने वाला कौन था?
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, stepping back frantically against the control panel, dropping the telephone receiver dangling on its cord, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सच यह था कि जो भी नया गेटमैन उस रजिस्टर में दस्तखत करता, उसकी बलि चढ़ जाती और पुरानी आत्मा आज़ाद हो जाती!
scenes.visual: A 58-year-old Indian man, weathered wrinkled face, bushy grey mustache, tired sunken eyes, stocky build, wearing a thick navy blue woolen sweater over a white faded kurta, wrapped in an olive-green muffler, standing outside on the cabin balcony, his face half-rotted and smiling sinisterly through the window, cold blue light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ठीक 2:40 पर एक जंग लगा स्टीम इंजन बिना पहियों की आवाज़ के पटरी पर हवा में तैरता हुआ निकला, और दरवाज़ा अपने आप चरमरा कर खुल गया।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, desperately throwing the ink pen onto the floor and refusing to sign the glowing cursed registry book, wide cabin shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: मैं तुम्हारी चाल में नहीं फंसूंगा! मैं दस्तखत नहीं करूंगा!
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, picking up a heavy iron chair to smash the back window of the cabin, determined defiance on his face, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: विक्रम ने खिड़की का शीशा तोड़ा और केबिन की बालकनी से नीचे जंगल की झाड़ियों में छलांग लगा दी।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, leaping out through the shattered wooden cabin window frame into the dark misty night, wide dynamic shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्योंकि उसने तीसरे नियम को समझकर रजिस्टर पर दस्तखत नहीं किए थे, इसलिए वह उस शापित केबिन की गिरफ्त से बच निकला।
scenes.visual: A 26-year-old Indian man, sharp jawline, anxious dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean athletic build, wearing a faded khaki railway employee uniform shirt with epaulets, dark grey trousers, brass belt buckle, limping through thick wet forest vegetation as the golden rays of dawn break through the tall sal trees, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आज भी केबिन नंबर 4 उसी जंगल में वीरान खड़ा है, किसी नए गेटमैन के इंतज़ार में। दोस्तों, कहानी कैसी लगी, कमेंट्स में ज़रूर बताएं। वीडियो को लाइक करें और चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।
scenes.visual: A solitary two-story colonial brick railway cabin beside rusted railway tracks in the misty morning light, an open door creaking softly in the breeze, abandoned and silent in the vast Indian forest, cinematic wide establishing shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगले हफ्ते मिलिए एक और रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाले किस्से के साथ—'कुलधरा के पुराने कुएं की वो रात, जब पानी ने आवाज़ दी!' शुक्रिया।
scenes.visual: An ancient dry stone stepwell under a blood-red twilight sky in a desert ghost town of Rajasthan, dark ominous shadows stretching across the carved steps, atmospheric wide shot.
